ideas.pitch: Real-time drone-to-dashboard crowd density and stampede early-warning system tailored for high-density Durga Puja pandals.
ideas.problem_statement: Natural Disaster Safety: Create solutions for disaster preparedness, early warning, emergency response, public safety, or disaster management.
ideas.title: DurgaPujoCrowdGuard
ideas.why_it_could_win: Aligns directly with the Natural Disaster Safety track and addresses local, highly visible safety challenges during festival seasons, capturing judges' attention through high societal impact.

ideas.pitch: An autonomous AI agent workflow that monitors emergency panic button triggers, coordinates local volunteer responses, and logs immutable incident trails.
ideas.problem_statement: Women Safety / Blockchain: Build technology solutions focused on women's safety and security. Blockchain-based approaches are welcome where relevant.
ideas.title: ShaktiShield Agent
ideas.why_it_could_win: Combines the AI-Agentic Solutions theme with Women Safety, leveraging agentic workflow automation which is a high-scoring category for technical judges.

ideas.pitch: An AI-powered festive diet planning and metabolic tracking assistant designed to help manage caloric intake during heavy festival sweets and food seasons.
ideas.problem_statement: Obesity Control & Medical Fitness: Build technology solutions focused on obesity prevention and management, including fitness tracking, health monitoring, progress tracking, and lifestyle management.
ideas.title: PujoFit Nutritionist
ideas.why_it_could_win: Directly targets the Obesity Control & Medical Fitness track with an immediate localized hook, utilizing proven meal-recommendation UX patterns.

ideas.pitch: A web-based interactive 3D and AR explorer for documenting and experiencing traditional Durga Puja idol craftsmanship and temple architecture.
ideas.problem_statement: Heritage & Culture: Create digital solutions to preserve, explore, promote, or experience cultural heritage. AR/VR is optional.
ideas.title: HeritageAR Archive
ideas.why_it_could_win: Fits the core Durga Puja cultural theme of the hackathon while delivering a polished, highly engaging frontend user experience.

ideas.pitch: An AI multi-agent system automating supply chain logistics, waste management scheduling, and volunteer shift allocation for community pandal organizers.
ideas.problem_statement: AI-Agentic Solutions: Build AI-powered systems that automate tasks, assist users, manage workflows, or solve real-world problems.
ideas.title: PujoPandal AgenticWorkflow
ideas.why_it_could_win: Hits the AI-Agentic Solutions track by solving a practical operations problem faced by every community organizing a massive public festival.
